outcome.technical: page-state.js: link validation moved to the registry. offeredBy(axis) derives the vocabulary from the toggles ([aria-pressed][attr]) carrying each axis's declared attrs plus an optional declared `twin` select; keptFromLink(axis, h) keeps per key what the axis's `takes` hook keeps, or with no hook the whole value when offered (takesOffered); FILTER_AXES is built as `[...].map((axis) => ({ ...axis, decode: (h) => axis.decode(keptFromLink(axis, h)) }))`, so every decode, including one added later with no hook, only sees checked values and no caller can bypass it. Entries' decodes went back to plain assignments; the exceptions are declared hooks: search takes free text, area takes tag-by-tag (twin areaSelect), dates take what a date field holds (dateFieldTakes); author declares twin auSelect. The registry publishes its keys as data-link-keys on the root. exports.js (not declared) is untouched; its restore loop still calls axis.decode(HASH), now the wrapped decode. markSpy's end-of-document clamp is removed. shell.css: :root{--sticky-anchor:calc(var(--sticky-2) + var(--sp-2))}, [id]{scroll-margin-top:var(--sticky-anchor)}, and @media screen{.snav ~ .content::after{...height:calc(100vh - var(--sticky-anchor))}}, so every target can reach the one line (named --sticky-* because the theme-symmetry lint treats that prefix as geometry; --anchor-line was flagged as a light-only colour token). Gate: hr0 reads data-link-keys at runtime, fails by name when it is absent, and fails if the free-text exemption ['q'] names a key the page no longer publishes; hr1 is red on an empty key set rather than passing vacuously; sn1 clicks every visible entry at every LAYOUT_SIZES size with the 'document ends before' note/carve-out removed; is11 hovers .snav a at 1000x800 (the strip presentation). Tests: _registry_text tolerates the .map close; new rx10 (check sits once on the registry, no decode reads controls, only area/dates/search declare takes) and sn0 (no end-of-document rule in markSpy, spacer and scroll-margin share --sticky-anchor, screen only); the anchor pin updated to the token. READMEs (report/, report-css/) updated.
